decisions.decision: Accept paired451 in place of the nonreproducible175 narrative peak for this comparison; retain all baselines and the2%floor.
decisions.quote: accept Linux SM89 12GB. Paired 451 old/new is -0.63% narrative / -1.74% code, both within 2%; the 90.89 narrative baseline (175, I8 cap 4096) is not reproducible by the old build today (88.84).
